summary: SM Energy filed an 8-K reporting the redemption of its 6.625% Senior Notes due 2027. On September 4, 2026, the company paid $416,791,000 to redeem all outstanding principal plus accrued interest, governed by an indenture dated May 21, 2015, as supplemented. The redemption satisfied all obligations under the indenture, and the notes and guarantees were cancelled. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special-situation event such as a tender offer or restructuring.
